title: Market Analysis for the Week of 11/1
ref_note: No roll this week (Dec contracts). ES text gives the July ETH low as 7324 but the list line says '7326 July ETH low' (wes3 tgt uses the RTH lows 7346/7247 he lists first; ETH 7324/7232 in text). 'Friday's low' / 'this past week's low' has no number in the letter (kept FRI_LOW). NQ 'this past week's high' (wnq4) resolved to the 30009 RTH high he names later; the ETH high may differ. NQ 'July low' target (wnq2) has no number in this letter. wes1 comes from the ES PRICE paragraph (filed under Trading Higher). ES list starts 'Will add higher if needed'; NQ list says 'See last week’s for higher'. Intro recap prices (7819.5, 7750-7752, 7712-7717, 7676-7681, 28944-29069, 28684-28722) not transcribed. Not made trades (borderline/requirements): ES 'Below 7644-7649, I think sellers retain a clearer advantage'; ES 'sellers come under meaningful pressure on any acceptance above 7725-7730'; ES acceptance below 7541-7543 → July/June/May lows (COMMENTARY, duplicate of wes3); ES back above the 7649 June high 'potential to come all the way back up' (no target); ES bounce must reclaim 7541-7543, the week low and 7644-7649 (preferably 7670-7677) (requirement); ES failed reclaims of 7703-7712/7725-7730 'are a risk'; ES 'simply rejecting one of those higher levels isn't enough'; NQ reclaim of Sept low 28878.75 and the 29k area (minimum requirements) and firm acceptance above 29380-29436 for a shift in control; NQ 'a failed reclaim [of 29380-29436] is a meaningful risk' and 'Either would require a fresh loss of 28847-28869 (as of now)'; NQ 28569-28583 'first order of business' Sunday night; NQ 'major test above 30210-30237' (zone only).

trades.name: reclaim of 7670-7677 without a LAAF → 7769-7772
trades.quote: Conversely, a reclaim of 7670-7677, which includes Friday's high, puts sellers under pressure to defend any excursion higher. Failure to produce a LAAF risks reversion toward 7769-7772 (at least 65).

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low + strong close (3-day balance)
trades.quote: A move below Friday's low that produces a LBAF and a strong close could set up Tuesday for a potential transition into a 3-day balance.

trades.name: acceptance below 7541-7543 → July/June lows
trades.quote: Acceptance below 7541-7543 very much risks a trip to the July and June lows (7346 and 7247 on an RTH basis and 7324 and 7232 on an ETH basis).

trades.name: sellers defend 7644-7649 → take out Friday's low
trades.quote: The first major upside test is 7644-7649. Stronger sellers (or at least more eager sellers) would defend there and then take out Friday’s low with continuation.

trades.name: LAAF of 7670-7677 (sellers MUST)
trades.condition: immediately or following a rejection at 7703-7712 or 7725-7730
trades.quote: Keep in mind that above 7670-7677 has ES back in October's value. Sellers MUST produce a LAAF or risk getting punished. That could happen immediately or following a rejection at 7703-7712 or 7725-7730.
trades.stop_hint: Sellers ultimately need to get price back below 7670-7677 to demonstrate control.

trades.name: firm acceptance above 7725-7730 → 7769-7772

trades.quote: 7541-7543* Monitor for LBAF

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low + strong Monday close (3-day balance)
trades.condition: followed by a strong Monday close and Tuesday continuation
trades.quote: A LBAF of Friday's low, followed by a strong Monday close and Tuesday continuation, could establish a 3-day balance and create the familiar box-trading opportunities.

trades.name: continuation below Friday's low (July low big picture)
trades.quote: Continuation below Friday’s low is objectively a continuation short. The July low is the big picture target, but we’ll be mindful of the cluster of the 200-day sma and YTD (and Jan high) VWAPs in the 27950-28144 range.

trades.name: fail/LAAF of 28847-28869
trades.quote: Any kind of fail/LAAF of 28847-28869 keeps NQ trapped in Friday’s range and is objectively bearish.

trades.name: firm acceptance above 29038-29069 → past week's high
trades.quote: Firm acceptance above 29038-29069 creates meaningful risk of a rotation all the way back toward this past week's high.

trades.name: gap-fill reversal at 29380-29436 (or rejection within the gap)
trades.quote: However, sellers have two particularly important opportunities to negate that scenario: a rejection within the bearish RTH gap, or a gap-fill reversal at 29380-29436.
